enchantment.nova_structures.antidote.des: Immune to magic damage (e.g. potions); poison wears down the chestplate.
enchantment.nova_structures.boss_behavio: Boss-only marker for Dungeons and Taverns bosses. Not obtainable gear.
enchantment.nova_structures.conductivity: During thunderstorms under open sky, lightning may strike you. Curse.
enchantment.nova_structures.ghasted.desc: Crossbow arrows explode in fire on impact (can break blocks); slower charge.
enchantment.nova_structures.gravity.desc: Crossbow arrow impacts pull nearby entities in; stronger per level.
enchantment.nova_structures.illagers_ban: +2.5 damage per level against illagers and related mobs.
enchantment.nova_structures.multishot.de: Tri-Shot: bow fires 3 arrows in a spread. Not with Infinity or Mending.
enchantment.nova_structures.outreach.des: +0.5 block-interaction reach per level (not attack reach).
enchantment.nova_structures.photosynthes: Slowly repairs itself in clear daylight under open sky. Not with Mending.
enchantment.nova_structures.piercing.des: Bow arrows pass through multiple entities. Not with Infinity or Mending.
enchantment.nova_structures.power.desc: Might: crossbow arrows deal more damage.
enchantment.nova_structures.shulker_boss: Boss-only marker: victims get Levitation II for 15 s. Not obtainable gear.
enchantment.nova_structures.shulker_mini: Boss-only marker: victims get Levitation III for 5 s. Not obtainable gear.
enchantment.nova_structures.traveler.des: Sprinting on ground: faster and steps up small ledges; occasional boot wear. Not with Soul Speed.
enchantment.nova_structures.wax_wings.de: Elytra no longer wears normally, but fast flight (worst in high, sunny skies) damages it. Not with Unbreaking.
enchantment.nova_structures.wither_coate: Hits inflict Wither for 8-10 s; extra weapon wear. Not with Fire Aspect.
